root_cause.text: The `mm/damon/core` subsystem failed to validate the `damos_quota_goal->nid` field before using it to access node-specific memory data structures, allowing untrusted user input to cause out-of-bounds memory access.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states that "DAMON core is using those for NODE-DATA() without a validation of the value," and the patch fixes this by adding an `if (invalid_mem_node(goal->nid))` check in `damos_get_node_memcg_used_bp` within `mm/damon/core.c` to reject invalid node IDs.
